name: Vile Brew

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

disable: DC 28 Crafting check (master) to swiftly dismantle key parts of the contraption containing the vile brew, or DC 31 Religion check (expert) to exorcise the haunt; three total successes in all are needed to disable the haunt
reset: The haunt deactivates at the start of any round in which no living creatures are in the room; it then reactivates 1 minute later.
routine: (3 actions) On its initiative, the churning awfulness extrudes a long, slimy tendril of clotted blood, tangled hair, and jagged broken teeth. These long, whiplike lengths then make three vile lash Strikes on three randomly determined targets in the room. With their reach and ability to manifest from any part of the machinery, these Strikes can target any creature in the room. They only target a creature more than once if there's not enough targets to split their attention.

items.name: Nightmare Recrudescence
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempts to use the brewing equipment, or at least one living creature spends 1 minute in the room

---
Effect The brewing equipment rattles to life as a hideous mash of what looks like clotted blood and body parts surges up and out of the machinery, pushing a nauseating stench into the room. All creatures in area C46 must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude save save or become Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). The haunt then rolls initiative.

items.name: Flesh Fermentation
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 26 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 poison damage and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 2d6 poison damage and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 poison damage, enfeebled 2 (1 round), and Drained 1

text: The brewing equipment begins to shudder and shake, and thick foamy sludge starts to bubble up out of the various pipes, tuns, and barrels—sludge that contains blinking eyes, screaming mouths, and twitching fingers among its turbulent mass!
